stance: Labour market is low-hire, low-fire. Initial claims sit near 199k with the 4-week average at 198.5k (prior 198.25k), and continuing claims are flat at 1.71M. No sign of a turn: that needs rising claims plus falling JOLTS openings plus soft payrolls, and only the claims leg is logged here, and it is not rising. Would change on a 4-week average above 215k or continuing claims above 1.8M. Stance is based on one release; no history yet.
